review_scope: Fixed first20 stable IDs per origin/generation stratum, all inventory counts retained.
findings: VALID canary is a construction control, never a human truth label.
Recovered VALID perturbations show generation method is not label provenance.
Temporal VALID records can retain failed DOI subtests; source availability differs from truth.
Human-coded supplement includes substantive bibliographic errors; no sentence truth target.
Core real-world rows have author review documented in the paper, but no disjoint per-entry adjudication protocol.
LLM-generated records have pipeline labels and database filtering, not documented independent model adjudication; classify unknown.
